t: Agents are replacing the "search, then act" workflow SN is built on.
d: Competitors now sell agents that find, research, and contact buyers on their own. SN's AI still assists a human.
ev: Apollo: "the first fully agentic GTM operating system designed to replace legacy sales tools" (2026-03-04)
Salesforce Prospecting Agent "autonomously hunts, ranks, and builds" prospect lists (2026-03-16)
SN Sales Assistant agent announced May 2025; current status unverified

t: SN is missing from where sellers now work: Claude and ChatGPT.
d: At least 9 competitors connect their data to AI assistants through MCP. We found no public SN equivalent.
ev: ZoomInfo GTM.AI connects Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Agentforce, Breeze (2026-06-01)
Lusha MCP on every plan including free (Oct 2026)
No SN MCP found: an inference from the absence of evidence

t: Seat pricing is now the outlier. Buyers are being trained to pay per result.
d: HubSpot charges $1 per recommended lead, Salesforce about $2 per lead worked, and Monaco and Clay charge for usage with no seats. SN is $119.99 a seat.
ev: HubSpot: $1.00 per lead recommended for outreach (2026-04-13)
Salesforce rate card: Leads Worked = 400 Flex Credits (2026-08-31)

t: The "best leads" moat is under the heaviest attack. The relationship moat is barely touched.
d: Nine competitors push large verified contact databases at agents. Only Unify directly targets warm paths through your network.
ev: Unify: "use my network (work or school overlap) to sell to Stripe"
Lusha: 515M+ contacts; extension reveals contacts on the professional network
Hunter bundles ZoomInfo, Demandbase, Apollo data

t: LinkedIn's first-party data is still the scarcest input, and that's SN's opening.
d: LinkedIn enforces against scrapers, and competitors market themselves as "not scraping". An agent-ready SN (MCP, usage tier, richer CRM feeds) would sell the one thing rivals can't copy.
ev: SN data in HubSpot is view-only: "not possible to import contacts"

t: Hands-on: the AI-native challengers gate trials hard, and Unify routes everything through chat.
d: Apollo rejected our research signup, Clay locked it, and Lusha demanded a phone number. Unify let us in, but it insists on a connected mailbox, prices AI through one credit pool, and caps LinkedIn at 10 touches a day. That cap is where Sales Navigator's network still wins.
ev: Unify onboarding: Connect Gmail or Outlook, no skip (hands-on, 2026-10-18)
Unify phone lookups cost 4-15 credits per task (hands-on)
Apollo: "Cannot sign up at this time" (hands-on)
Clay: account locked for fraud protection (hands-on)
